digest: HEAD 654f639 changes stop/cancel behavior with no tests and a renamed public field. Medium overall impact: the rename and the widened cancellation match can break consumers or misclassify real timeouts. Security and performance impact is low.

impacts.summary: WorkflowTerminalSummary.launchRetryAttempts was renamed to launchRetries (src/workflow-terminal.ts:33,107). SPEC T3 names the old field as public, so external readers of the summary will break unless a compatibility alias is kept.

isWorkflowReturnedCancellation (src/workflow-cancellation.ts:20) now treats 'cancelled' and 'timeout' as cancellation. A provider timeout can be recorded as a user cancellation, which hides the failure cause and can change retry or terminal-status handling.
No test files exist (Glob for *.test/*.spec found none), and package.json has only typecheck. SPEC Q1 requires a unit test per S/C/T item, so none of the three behavior changes is covered by a test.

HEAD diverges from SPEC.md in four places: pollMs default 200 vs S3's 50, the extra cancellation keywords vs C1, the retry field name vs T3, and stop-error detection. Either the code or the spec is wrong, and the release contract is unclear.

createWorkflowStopSignal polls with setInterval at a 200ms default (src/workflow-stop.ts:67,81). The change lowers polling frequency, so stop requests take up to about 200ms to take effect. Disk load drops, which is the intended effect.

The change adds no new input source, secret handling, or network path. Cancellation matching is a string match on error, reason, details, and content fields, so widening the keyword set is a classification risk, not an injection path.

assumptions.note: The exact diff of 654f639 was not readable. Changed files were inferred from the commit message, the upstream control artifacts, and a grep of src/ (verified: pollMs at workflow-stop.ts:67, keywords at workflow-cancellation.ts:16-20, launchRetries at workflow-terminal.ts:33,107).
store.js and types.js are not in the repo, so readWorkflowStopIntent and the WorkflowRunRecord shapes could not be checked.
No external consumer of launchRetries or launchRetryAttempts was found inside this repo.
The previous pollMs value is not known from the upstream artifacts; the 50ms figure comes from SPEC S3, not from the parent commit.
